test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following pie chart shows funds spent by the government on various public activities. All the values are given in crores. Study the pie chart and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91be7bcd31118d3c918d72f5bf332d0402d1e558558c01e0c20f5186f44b896b.png] 

What is the sum of the ‘difference between the funds spent on security and education’ and the ‘funds spent on health’ (in crores)?
solution:
**Given:**

Fund spent on security = 70 crores

Fund spent on education = 30 crores

Fund spent on health = 60 crores

**Calculation:**

Difference between the funds spent on security and education = 70 - 30

⇒ 40 crores

The sum of the ‘difference between the funds spent on security and education and the funds spent on health,

⇒ 40 + 60 = 100 crores

**∴ The correct answer is 100 crores.**
